```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

get_predictions <- function(path, ending){
  file_paths <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = paste0("\\.", ending, "$"), full.names = TRUE))
  file_names <- sub(paste0("\\.", ending, "$"), "", basename(file_paths))
  data_list <- lapply(file_paths, read_csv)
  names(data_list) <- file_names
  combi <- data_list %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y)) %>% mutate(label = tolower(label))
  return(combi)
}

corona_all <- get_predictions("combi_out_ot/covid/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")
hsv_all <- get_predictions("combi_out_ot/hsv/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")
hiv_all <- get_predictions("combi_out_ot/hiv/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")


corona_filtered <- get_predictions("filtered_outputs/corona/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")
hsv_filtered <- get_predictions("filtered_outputs/hsv/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")
hiv_filtered <- get_predictions("filtered_outputs/hiv/drug_prioritization/drugstone/", "trustrank.csv")
```
